Enjoy better focus and productivity by trying out the Pomodoro technique, thanks to our built-in Pomodoro mode.

The idea behind the Pomodoro technique is that you can work more effectively when you work in timed, 25-minute increments (with breaks in between). Our Pomodoro timer automatically tracks your time in 25-minute increments, with notifications, a full screen mode, and countdown timer to really help you stay focused and on task.

◼ Favorites
Favorites allows you to create shortcuts to frequently used time entries. Start tracking time on a favorite time entry with one tap.

◼ Notifications
Enable notifications so that you always know if & what are you tracking (or if you're not tracking anything!), and always be aware where does your time go.

◼ Customize your time entries with projects, clients and tags
Organize and add more details to your time entries by adding projects, clients and tags. Clearly see where your work hours go and adjust your precious time & routines accordingly.

◼ Shortcuts
By using @ and #, you can quickly add those projects and tags much faster and get back to work right away!

◼ Widgets
Place a Toggl Track widget on your Home Screen to see your timer running — and to start or stop a time entry.

◼ Sync
Your time is safe with us - phone, desktop or web, your time is seamlessly synced and kept safe between all of your devices.

◼ Manual Mode
Want more control? Add and edit all of your time manually and make sure that every second of your time is accounted for. This feature is optional and it's accessible from the Settings menu.

◽ But what if I'm offline?
No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync with your account (and the rest of your devices) - your time (and money!) is not going anywhere.

◽ Is the app free?
Yes, Toggl Track for Android is completely free for you to use. Not only that, there are no ads at all - ever!

◽ Can I send you some feedback?
You betcha (and we'd love to hear from you)! You can send us feedback directly from the app - look for the 'Submit Feedback' in the Settings menu.

And that's Toggl Track - a time tracker so simple that you'll actually use it and get things done! Track important tasks, use reports to see how you spend your time and boost your productivity. Whether you are at an office, in commute, stuck on a space mission to Mars or just want to see how much time you're wasting on projects that aren't bringing you money - track your time anywhere you go!

Project Hours is available on Android, iPhone and (mobile) web site, users with different devices can track hours together on projects.

Project Hours supports:
- Define projects and activities.
- Define materials.

- Register materials you have used on projects.

- You can approve hours of employees for a certain time period. Hours will locked after approval. Employees can no longer edit time in the locked period.
- Plan hours in advance for your employees. You can plan per weekday for multiple users. Employees will see the planning and are able to make adjustments to reflect actual hours worked.
- Categorize projects and activities. This allows for more advanced reports with totals per category. This is for instance useful if you want to see hours per product line or any other category that applies to your organistation. You can can export an excel file with all time entries and categories for reporting.

Try the 2 months free trial period to discover if Project Hours works for your company! The long trial period will give you the opportunity to collect hours for a over a month and see if the reporting suits you.

Administrative functions like creating new users and view reports are currently available on the website, we are working on including these features in the app.

Project Hours pricing policy is to be the most affordable time tracking system out there, costs are €2 / $2.20 per month per user, you will receive an annual invoice.

Recently we made many new enhancements to Project Hours. You can now for instance make an overview of budgeted hours. This allows for monitoring progress of your team and compare actual registered hours with budgeted. This feature is available on the project hours website.

Other updates include more data available for download in Excel, such as an overview of materials registered and a download of planned hours.

Of course, if you have questions or feature requests, do not hesitate to contact us via info@projecthours.net.

name: DriverLog Logbook
description:
DriverLog is the simplest to operate, most complete and most versatile electronic Hours Of Service solution.
DriverLog is both a mobile app that can be installed on any Android device, and is an integrated Fleet management application (can be integrated into 3rd party solutions or our Wireless Links Fleet.Net)

On the server side, DriverLog provides the dispatcher with complete visibility of the status of every driver in the HOS shift and cycle including replay of daily history and comprehensive reports.

To meet different customer requirements and specific system configurations to send data from the ECM to the ELD and then to upload and synchronize the ELD with the server, Driver Log is packaged with multiple hardware solutions that plug into the vehicle ECM and sends the J1939 and J1708 protocols to the ELD via Bluetooth or WIFI, learn more by clicking this link http://www.wlius.com/hos

This is a partial list of the DriverLog functionalities :
• Automatically calculates and displays current and available driving and on duty time in drivers’ shift and cycle.
• Allows review of six months of day-by-day history.
• Allows editing logs (while recording the edit)
• Alerts the driver of upcoming shift and/or cycle time violations
• Fully integrated with DVIR.
• Automatic driving and stop status detection.
• Automatically uploads to the server via cellular or WIFI every event in real time, so the dispatcher has a complete real time visibility of the drivers’ status within the HOS shift and cycle.
• No data can be lost – the data on the Android device synchronizes real time with the server and is being backed up on the server. In case that the Android device is broken or lost, the driver’s data is downloaded from the server automatically to the new Android device.
• The identical logs displayed on the driver’s Android device are also displayed and printable on the management console.
• DriverLog is fully integrated with Wireless Links Fleet.Net GPS based fleet management system or if you already have a fleet management system DriverLog can be an independent standalone system.
• For integrators DriverLog can be fully integrated into any 3rd party fleet management and/or dispatch application.
• DriverLog has the option to send real time GPS data to a fleet management system, saving the need for a separate GPS unit

To use this feature, you don’t need to modify your car! You just require a Bluetooth adapter which is plugged in to the cars OBDII interface. Installation is very easy since in most modern cars the OBDII interface is directly beneath the steering wheel.
For more information please read here: https://triptracker.app/obdii
NOTE: Wifi Adapters are not supported anymore due to some Android limitations.


** Security **
TripTracker provides complete and correct data collection. The mileage logbook’s integrity is ensured by various hash and encryption algorithm. Each entry has its own checksum to guarantee that it isn't changed afterwards or outside of TripTracker. The generated PDF can be signed by one of our servers to ensure that it can't be modified.

** Privacy **
In contrary to most other systems all the collected data is your property. It is not stored somewhere abroad on a Server or a Cloud. The mileage logbook is on your phone in a local high performance SQL database.
TripTracker does not sell or analyze your mileage logbook!!

** Backend **
TripTracker has a powerful synchronization mechanism that allows you to collect and edit your mileage logbook across multiple devices. There is also a web interface which allows you to analyze your data on a PC or Mac.

Privacy policy:
https://triptracker.app/privacy

CAT Scale’s Weigh My Truck™ application revolutionizes how professional truck drivers weigh their truck. The Weigh My Truck™ app will also email a PDF copy scale ticket or weight information text file to up to five email addresses the driver specifies, saving the driver time that could be spent on the road instead of finding a place to park and standing in line.
If the driver does need a hard copy scale ticket for billing purposes, they can still pick up a printed CAT Scale ticket at the fuel desk within an hour after weighing using the Weigh My Truck™ application.

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

Bridge Scale Axle Calculation – Instantly compute steering, drive, and trailer weights as you roll over bridge scales

Tandem Hole Guidance – Get recommendations for sliding trailer tandems to the correct hole after scaling

Fuel Optimizer – Know exactly how much fuel to add or burn to stay within legal truck axle weight limits

Wind Advisor – Receive safety tips for lighter loads in windy conditions

State Weight Limit Info – Access up-to-date regulations across U.S. states

Estimate axle weights using payload from the Bill of Lading and load arrangement—no scale required

name: Jolly Classroom
description:
Make Teaching Phonics & Grammar Easy with Jolly Classroom!
Jolly Classroom is a comprehensive, interactive classroom app designed to support teachers in delivering systematic phonemic awareness, spelling, grammar and punctuation lessons with ease. With over 150 structured lessons, engaging activities and built-in phonics assessments, this app ensures that students develop strong reading and writing skills in a fun and research-backed way.

A Complete Classroom Solution
Jolly Classroom provides a structured, step-by-step approach to teaching phonics, grammar and spelling. Aligned with the Science of Reading, the app focuses on building essential phonemic awareness, reading fluency and writing accuracy in a way that is engaging and easy to follow.

What is Jolly Phonics?
Jolly Phonics is a programme for teaching reading and writing. It is based on a systematic synthetic phonics approach and was developed by teachers Sue Lloyd and Sara Wernham. It is the first stage in teaching children to read and write using the 5 key skills. It focuses on direct, explicit instruction of phonemic awareness and phonics for both reading (decoding) and writing (encoding). Scientific research has consistently shown phonemic awareness to be essential for building strong reading, spelling and writing skills.

Why Choose Jolly Classroom?
1. Phonics Programme – Bring phonemic awareness to your school with interactive activities and clear instructions
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation – Course introducing complex concepts of English Grammar in a fun and easy way
3. Built-in Phonics Assessments – Includes Jolly Phonics assessments and phonics screening tests to track student progress
4. Teacher-Friendly – Simple school setup with customisable staff and student profiles
5. Multi-Sensory Learning – Animated guidance, blending & segmenting tools and audio support make learning engaging for all students
6. British & American English Options – Tailor your teaching experience to suit different curriculums

Key Features That Make Learning Effective
1. Phonics Lessons - Step-by-step systematic phonics instruction, including 72 tricky words, helping children learn to read and write confidently
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation - Develop core English skills with structured lessons designed for classroom success
3. Phonics Assessments - built-in phonics assessments that help a school track student progress and prepare effectively for the Phonics Screening Check
4. Interactive Activities - Fun animations and audio support for letter formation, blending and segmenting
5. Progress Tracking - Monitor individual and class performance

Who Is Jolly Classroom For?
1. School – A curriculum-aligned solution for developing reading and writing skills
2. Teachers – A powerful classroom resource for structured phonics and grammar instruction
3. Pupils – Designed for early learners to master phonics, spelling and grammar through interactive lessons
4. Homeschool – An excellent tool for homeschool parents teaching their children at home with a structured, easy-to-follow program

Jolly Classroom is also an excellent resource for English learners, providing a structured and engaging way to build phonemic awareness, reading fluency and English grammar proficiency. With its systematic approach to teaching letter sounds, blending and sentence formation, the app helps English as a Second Language (ESL) students develop confidence in reading and writing. The interactive lessons and audio-supported activities ensure that learners can hear correct pronunciation, practice spelling and improve their understanding of grammar and sentence structure in an accessible way. Whether in a school or a homeschool setting, Jolly Classroom makes mastering English grammar and phonics easy!

Transform Your Classroom Today!
Join thousands of educators using Jolly Classroom to teach phonics, spelling and grammar with confidence.

Download now and bring phonics lessons into your school!

description:
Inner Explorer Classroom App – the best mindfulness program designed for teachers, students, and families. Our app features 180 audio-guided mindfulness practices designed for four age groups, from Early Learning through 12th grade. Inner Explorer’s model is based on the renowned Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) protocol, which has been proven to reduce stress, enhance academic performance, and improve self-regulation skills.

Our practices are narrated by diverse ethnic backgrounds, making them culturally intentional and accessible to all. Additionally, the Early Learning and Elementary programs are available in Spanish, and have been approved by CASEL as an “SEL-Related Approach.”

With Inner Explorer, mindfulness can be incorporated into any part of the day. Whether you’re a teacher looking to enhance student readiness to learn, a student hoping to improve impulse control, or a family wanting to lead a healthier, happier life, Inner Explorer has something for everyone.
Our daily mindfulness practice has been proven to reduce perceived stress by 43%, enhance student readiness to learn, lower behavioral issues by up to 60%, and improve impulse control, among many other benefits.

App Features:

• Four age-appropriate programs to choose from: Early Learning-1st Grade, Elementary, Middle and High School
• 180 audio practices per program, 5 minutes in length for Early Learning-1st Grade, 10 minutes for Elementary, Middle and High School (including 2 minutes of journaling)
• Counselor Series Targeted practices were created to support counselors in their individual or small group work with students.
• Educator Wellbeing Series Designed specifically for educators to use whenever they choose to reduce their stress and feel appreciated.
• Shorter Transition and Sound audio practice options
• Spanish practices available for Early Learning - Elementary programs (Middle School coming soon)
• Our app features an exclusive Tune In feature that allows you to invite parents and caregivers to listen in real-time to the mindfulness practices taking place in your classroom. This feature provides transparency and bridges the gap between school and home, giving families a deeper insight into their child's mindfulness practice.
• Experience mindfulness on any device with Inner Explorer Classroom App's specially designed iPad and mobile versions. Enjoy a seamless experience across all platforms, with your progress synced automatically. Whether you're at home, at school, or on the go, you can continue your mindfulness practice without missing a beat.

Testimonial:
“Our whole community really loves IE! I include information in my weekly newsletter also and the parents are very excited about it. It is so easy for teachers to use and the students are very engaged in the audios and sessions.” Lindsey Keener, Principal, SF Public Montessori

The Inner Explorer Classroom App can be downloaded free of cost, and new users will have access to 21 tracks out of 180 to practice mindfulness as a part of their initial experience. The app also offers monthly and yearly subscriptions to gain access to all 180 practices per program. Monthly subscriptions are available for $19.99 per month, and yearly subscriptions are available for $199.99 per year.

Subscription prices vary for users outside of the United States due to Google's currency conversion rates. Monthly and yearly subscriptions will renew automatically 24 hours before the end of the chosen period and will be charged to the user's Google Play account.

Users can turn off the auto-renewal at any time through their Google Play account settings, but refunds are not provided for unused portions of the current paid period.

name: flixGRADE the best teacher app
description:
FlixGRADE is the ultimate app for teachers to manage participation grades. It offers comprehensive support for classroom management, focusing on recognizing and documenting student participation. This goal is enhanced by a functional seating chart with versatile input and display options. FlixGRADE stands out for its user-friendly interface, clear presentation, extensive range of features, and flexible configuration options.

Easy to use:

- Ideal for smartphones and tablets
- No tedious scheduling of lessons
- Uncomplicated entry of student data and grades
FlixGRADE simplifies the daily teaching routine: Open a class, enter student information, and the lesson begins. All data is saved with the current date. Participation grades can be entered directly without prior setup. Other student achievements, such as vocabulary tests, can be defined once and used multiple times for grade entries.

Clear presentation:

- All entries for a day at a glance
- Seating plan for more overview
- Current grade status and number of evaluations
- Inclusively educated students
- All active checklists with processing status
- Entries and remarks about the student in the previous lesson
All entries start with the student, whether in the seating plan or the student list, and are displayed on one screen for the current day. The next day, the entries can be found on the detail pages of the students. The student list and seating plan are then free of entries again, making it easier for the teacher to track which evaluations were entered for that day.

Extensive features:

- Multiple selection and batch entries for efficient work
- Group assistant and random generator
- Participation trend through visual regression line
- Flexible, freely definable grading systems
- Calculation of grade suggestions
- Coursebook for documenting the course of the lesson
- Integration of pictures of classes, students, and learning products
Entries can be made for multiple students simultaneously, and serial entry enables a quick, systematic assessment of the participation. The group assistant makes it easier to form groups with homogeneous performance.

New data protection concept:

- Minimal data framework
- Encrypted data
- No central server
- Automatic deletion
- Grade export via email
The FlixGRADE teacher app offers a comprehensive data protection concept in accordance with the GDPR. Student data remains on the mobile device and is encrypted. Student data is not transmitted to a central server. FlixGRADE restricts itself to the most essential data and uses neutral descriptions. The grades and the number of assessments and days of absence can be saved via email export. All entries for a student are automatically deleted after a defined period.

Free for up to 4 learning groups and 80 students. After that, the app can be unlocked for unlimited students and classes through an in-app purchase (approximately €1 per month).

FlixGRADE, the teacher app for an efficient day in the classroom, offers far more possibilities than a conventional teacher calendar or planner. Check it out and make your teaching easier!

Best regards,
Stefan Heizmann
Mitarbeitsapp GmbH

name: Planit Pro: Photo Planner
description:
Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

name: Sectograph. Day & Time planner
description:
🎯 Sectograph is a new, intuitive way to view your calendar and daily schedule.

It shows your day as a circular planner — a 12-hour clock face — with events and free time between them.
A visual time planner for time blocking, time management, and a clearer sense of time.


⚙️ HOW IT WORKS

Sectograph is lightweight, privacy-friendly, and works with your existing calendars on the device.
It overlays your day planner (routine, local calendar, Google Calendar) onto a clock-face timeline and automatically calculates:

• upcoming events
• time blocks and durations
• gaps between events and your real free time

Everything updates as time passes, keeping your schedule always current.
Not a to-do list — it’s a calendar-based schedule planner that visualizes what’s already on your calendar.


👀 HOW IT LOOKS

Like an analog clock your brain already understands — but with your day mapped onto it as sectors.

• Events appear exactly in the hours they happen (a radial / circular calendar view)
• Each sector width matches the event duration (a true pie-chart schedule)
• See gaps and the time from “now” to the next event at a glance

A clock planner / visual planner that helps you read your day instantly.


🎯 USE CASES & IDEAS

Use Sectograph as a day planner, daily planner, time planner, or routine planner for time management and daily schedule planning.
Great for time blocking (deep work, meetings, breaks), work/shift schedules, class schedules, travel itineraries, and Pomodoro planning (place focus sessions as time blocks).
If you like Chronodex, you’ll feel right at home.


🔄 SYNC & CALENDARS

Reads events from Google Calendar and your local device calendar; Microsoft Outlook calendar: beta.


📱 HOME SCREEN CALENDAR WIDGET

Keep your schedule always visible with a calendar widget / home screen widget.

• Automatic updates (including a clock refresh once a minute)
• Tap a sector to open details and quick actions
• Flexible visual settings + free widget themes: Dark / White / Gray
• Optional: light/dark app theme, 24-hour mode & extra zoom (1–12h), month/day grid views


⌚ WEAR OS (SMARTWATCH SUPPORT)

A true Wear OS calendar / smartwatch calendar at a glance:

• Watch app with an interactive widget
• Tile for quick access to the circular planner
• Watch face for continuous schedule awareness (installed separately)
• Large complication to enhance some third-party watch faces


🧠 HELPFUL FOR ADHD & “TIME BLINDNESS”

Designed to make time easier to grasp — especially if you struggle with time blindness, which is common for people with ADHD.
(Sectograph is not a medical app.)

✅ Install Sectograph and get a calm, visual overview of your day.

name: Exposure Calculator
description:
Capture the Light, Forget the Math.

Ever find yourself staring at a waterfall, holding a 10-stop ND filter, and trying to divide 1/125 by "darkness" in your head? We’ve all been there.

Whether you’re shooting long-exposure seascapes or pushing film in a vintage Leica, Exposure Calculator handles the arithmetic so you can focus on the art. It’s the Swiss Army knife for your camera bag—minus the bulky metal and the risk of cutting your thumb.

The Full Creative Toolkit

• The Master Calculator: Swap Aperture, Shutter Speed, or ISO on the fly. Set any two, and we’ll tell you the third. It’s like magic, but with physics.
• The ND Stack-O-Matic: Stack up to 3 ND filters (up to 30 stops!) without breaking a sweat. Perfect for turning choppy waves into mist or making tourists disappear from busy streets.
• Bulb & Long Exposure: From 4 seconds to 24 hours. We’ve even included a built-in timer and alarm, so you can go grab a coffee while your sensor drinks in the light.
• Reciprocity Failure: Film photographers, we see you. Account for the quirks of your favorite emulsion with the optional compensation wheel.

Pro Tools for Precision

• ND Calibration: Not all filters are created equal. Calibrate yours for pinpoint accuracy.
• Reverse Search: Know the look you want but not the filter you need? Work backward to find the perfect ND value.
• EV Readout: Get the Exposure Value of your scene at a glance.
• Night Vision Protection: Don't ruin your rods and cones. Use the custom color night mode to keep your eyes adjusted to the dark.

Why You’ll Love It

• Extreme Ranges: From f/1.0 to f/360 and ISO 0.4 to 3.2M.
• Total Customization: Define your own increments (1, 1/2, or 1/3 stops).
• Presets: Save your go-to setups for instant access.
• Pure & Clean: No ads, no tracking, and no personal data collection.

Stop guessing. Start calculating. Your sensor (and your brain) will thank you.

name: Shot Designer
description:
Shot Designer is a ground-breaking tool for Directors and DPs that creates Animated Camera Diagrams, with integrated Shot List, Storyboards, Professional Director's Viewfinder, and Sync & Team Sharing via the Hollywood Camera Work cloud at no extra cost.

WHAT IS SHOT DESIGNER?

• CAMERA DIAGRAM - Shot Designer dramatically speeds up the Director's process of making camera diagrams. Create full-blown diagrams in minutes. The software does most of the work.
• ANIMATION - Animate your characters and cameras to move around your diagram in real-time. Previsualize the rhythm of a scene by seeing it play out.
• SHOT LIST - The integrated Shot List is tied into the diagram and writes itself while you work. Edit shots intuitively in the diagram, not in a confusing spreadsheet.
• DIRECTOR'S VIEWFINDER / STORYBOARDS - Bring in lens-accurate camera angles via the integrated Director's Viewfinder or Storyboard Import.
• MAC/PC DESKTOP VERSION - An identical Mac/PC Desktop Version is included with the Pro Version (in-app upgrade).
• SYNC & TEAM SHARING VIA DROPBOX - Sync your scenes across all your devices. Share scene folders with teams. Control who owns which scene. (Pro Feature)

Watch the feature-demo at http://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/shot-designer-videos.html

CAMERA-BLOCKING ON STEROIDS

Shot Designer was developed by Per Holmes, the creator of the Hollywood Camera Work training.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. Animate characters and cameras with simple Walk To and Track To commands. Create sophisticated tracking shots with multiple marks. Shot Designer is fast enough that you can rearrange the diagram with actors waiting.

OTHER FEATURES

• Integrated Set Designer for building floor plans.
• Integrated Lighting Designer for DPs, with lighting symbols provided by Ari Golan of Atomic Imaging Studios Chicago.
• Import production drawings as backgrounds and block on top of them.
• Factory Templates of pre-made camera setups for any situation.
• Make your own templates as starting points for new scenes.
• Large and growing prop/furniture library. Email us requests, we'll build them.
• Scene Freeze: Experiment easily by taking snapshots you can return to (Pro).
• PDF/JPG/Excel export and emailing of Camera Diagrams and Shot Lists (Pro).
• Unlimited Folder Structure for organizing scenes (Pro).

The Free Version of Shot Designer is full-featured except for Save and Export. Your current scene is always saved, and you can be fully productive working on one scene at a time. The Pro Version (in-app upgrade) adds File Management, identical Mac/PC Desktop Version, PDF/JPG/Excel Export, Scene Freeze and more.

Notion has been featured in various worldwide campaigns and has won several awards, including a prestigious music industry NAMM TEC Award for Best Smartphone/Tablet App.

REAL TIME NOTIFICATIONS
Members of shared calendars get real time updates and notifications when they are added to the calendar, and when events are added or updated.

JOINING SHARED CALENDARS IS SO EASY

KNOW HOW’S ATTENDING

MINIMALIST DESIGN & USER FRIENDLY

CROSS PLATFORM

WEAR OS

This app provides schedules and frequencies for shortwave radio broadcasts throughout the world. Information is also included on some utility stations, Firedrake jammer etc.

Information is taking from the Eibi schedule (http://www.eibispace.de/) and AOKI Schedule.

Location permissions are for mapping features for Google Maps API and displaying your current location on a map.

Premium Version is available as an In App Purchase which adds:

*"Now" feature showing stations currently on air in each SW band
*Favourites tab to store and easily lookup frequencies of favourite stations
*SDR audio option to play live station audio through a selection of SDRs including Twente WebSDR and various KiwiSDRs. More SDR options coming soon.

*If you want to donate to the author please also purchase this IAP to buy me a beer*

The app has the following free features (which will always be free):

*Schedules easily updated from Eibi and stored on device meaning data connection is not needed once schedules are downloaded.
* Search by time showing all stations broadcasting to a chosen target area at a specific time
* Search by station showing either complete station schedule and frequencies or only broadcasts of a station at a chosen time
* Search by frequency to identify a station you are listening to either at a specific time or any time.
* Search by language to find stations only broadcasting in a specific language.
* Shows maps of transmitters location and beam direction from AOKI list
* Log your DX catches, record audio recordings of the station and share your logs using Android share options.
*Dark mode

Results show the station name, the broadcast start and end time, the target area of the station (EU, Asia, Africa, North America etc.) and a list of frequencies including the transmitter location (swipe across to see more frequencies)

Thanks to David Giménez for the translation into Spanish and Paolo Romani for the Italian translation.

If you have any comments or suggestions please email me.

👍 RECOMMENDED BY EXPERTS

Jessica McCabe from “How to ADHD” recommends TimeTune as an ideal tool to build solid routines and give structure to your day.

😀 WHAT IS TIMETUNE?

TimeTune is a schedule planner and time blocking app. Use it to organize your agenda, plan routines and increase your productivity.

Do you know why some people can get plenty of things done in a single day while your time slips through your fingers?

The answer is that they have a very structured distribution of time. They organize their agenda with a planner and have strong time management habits. That allows them to seize the day and complete their tasks.

With TimeTune Schedule Planner you can do the same.

👩‍🔧 HOW DOES IT WORK?

TimeTune uses time blocks to build your agenda. Just add time blocks to your day or use time blocks to build templates that can be reused at any time, like a morning routine or a timetable.

Templates allow you to plan upcoming schedules, routines, timetables or work shifts in a flash. You will enjoy an automated agenda.

TimeTune Schedule Planner also shows you statistics to see where the time goes. Check them to see if your time is correctly structured and how you can improve.

You can add custom reminders to your time blocks, so you don’t forget your agenda: reminders with custom vibrations, custom sounds, voice, etc (ideal if you have ADHD).

With TimeTune Schedule Planner you can create a time management system as simple or as complex as you need. This daily planner will allow you to finally complete your tasks and save time.

🤓 WHY DOES IT WORK?

Time blocking is a scheduling method that divides your day into smaller segments of time for specific tasks. If you add statistics, you get the perfect time management system to optimize your productivity.

A structured day increases focus and motivation. Time blocking on a daily planner allows you to concentrate on the task at hand and avoid distractions.

As Cal Newport, author of “Deep Work” states:

“Time blocking generates a massive amount of productivity. A 40-hour time-blocked work week produces the same amount of output as a 60+ hour work week without structure”

It’s no wonder high achievers like Benjamin Franklin, Bill Gates and many others embraced this planning method and used a daily planner to organize their agenda in a structured way.

Also, for people with ADHD, time blocking can be a crucial approach to tackle their agenda and avoid anxiety. If you have ADHD, TimeTune Schedule Planner allows you to focus on each task, improve your daily routine and see where the time actually goes.

🤔 WHAT CAN I DO WITH TIMETUNE?

With TimeTune Schedule Planner you can:

★ Avoid anxiety and burnout
★ Do everything in your agenda
★ Do tasks in time if you have ADHD

🙋 WHO IS IT FOR?

If you would like to do more things with your time, TimeTune Schedule Planner is for you.

description:

By using sustained drones to create a tonal foundation, you’ll learn to recognize scale degrees based on their *feeling*, not just how they sound.

The app offers a variety of ways to train:
* Degrees Mode - Identify individual notes against the drone by feeling. The heart of SET.
* Melody Mode - Identify short melodic phrases, preparing you for real music.
* Voice Mode - Sing the requested scale degree into your microphone.
* Pocket Mode - Hands-free training for when you're on the go.
* Free Play - An interactive instrument for exploration.

With its intuitive, color-coded interface, thoughtfully designed progression path, and multiple difficulty levels, SET adapts to your skill level while keeping practice engaging. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced musician, SET is your guide to unlocking true musical fluency through intuitive, feeling-based ear training.

Our loop pause countdown lets you know when to start playing again.

Teachers can make Practice Bird their own by uploading their own musicXML and MIDI sheet music files for their students.

PRACTICE
Practice is the best of all instructors! And with Practice Bird, the more notes you play correctly, the more practice points you can collect, making practice even more fun. No matter what instrument you play, Practice Bird will adapt to you! With our Automatic Page Turning feature, there is no need to manually turn the page and lose focus. The built-in metronome is there to keep you playing in time with the music. Need to practice the hardest part of the piece? Use the Loop feature. The best thing about it is that you can even set breaks during the loops to catch your breath. Need to transpose a single part of a piece? That’s an easy fix with Practice Bird.

name: Baby: Breastfeeding Tracker
description:
This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements. This baby tracker app will help parents get through the wonder weeks.

With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
✔️ Handy breastfeeding timer and sleep timer are easy to stop and to restart
✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

name: Breastfeeding Newborn tracker
description:
The simplest program to track breastfeeding, pumping, bottle feeding, solid food consumption, diapers, sleep schedule, height and weight, and more.

In the application, you can share baby's data with your partner, relatives, or nanny. Syncing data between multiple devices is available for free.

The birth of a baby is a miracle that fills your heart with joy! A mother’s life changes dramatically with the birth of her baby. It is so important for a mother and her newborn baby to establish a comfortable breastfeeding relationship. Moms need to keep track of which breast to offer her baby, how long the baby suckles at each breast, the number of times the baby breastfeeds each day, how many wet diapers and bowel movements the baby has, how long and frequently the baby sleeps, as well as the baby’s weight and growth. All of this information is important for the self-assessment of breastfeeding and for assessing the growth of the child. Having this information easily accessible will be extremely useful when visiting with your pediatrician or lactation consultant.

It is important to record all of this data. Do not rely on your memory, because even the most organized mothers are often lost in the sea of information about their newborn.

Use the features of the Breastfeeding application.

Breastfeeding and pumping:
- record the time and quantity of feedings and / or pumpings;
- note which breast was fed or pumped last to ensure starting new feeding/pumping on the opposite breast;
- record the duration of feeding / pumping;
- pause feeding / pumping, if necessary;
- brief feedings / pumpings, or those that occur within a short period of time, are grouped into one feeding / pumping event
- quickly add feeding / pumping session that was similar to the most recent but update with current time
- use the maximum duration of feeding setting and the application will stop recording the feeding / pumping at the set time if you are unable to press stop

Liquids:
- consider all of your child’s fluid intake (water, expressed breast milk, formula, juice, etc.);
-track your child’s reactions to new fluids and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers;
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Feeding (solid food):
- add solid foods as your child begins eating them (cereal, vegetables, fruits, meat, fish);
- track your child’s reactions to these new foods and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Sleep:
- record the time and duration of your baby’s sleep each day so you can better plan your day;
- compare your baby’s sleep habits with recommended sleep guidelines


Diapers:
- track the number of your baby’s wet and / or dirty diapers. This information is crucial for noticing signs of dehydration, constipation, and diarrhea and alerting the child’s pediatrician if necessary.

Measurements:
- track height and weight to evaluate your baby’s development;

Other features:
- edit or delete events as needed;
- set reminders for various events;
- use the application in your native language (more than 40 languages available);
- select your preferred units of measurement (ounces or milliliters);
- browse graphs;
- view statistics;
- enter data for several children and twins;
- backup all of your data;
and more!

PRO-version
- disable advertising;
- install widgets for quick viewing and launch;
- auto backup every 24 hours;
- export to Excel


We are constantly working to improve the application. Write to us with questions and suggestions.

Enjoy watching your healthy baby grow!

This senior health app helps a person establish and maintain daily mental and physical health routines. Features sensors, daily recurring tasks and reminders to help a person improve their ability to self-care.

A remote family member can receive an automatic notification telling them what time their loved one woke up (which is nice and reassuring), and more notifications throughout the day: what time they took their medicine; if they went outside for a walk, and what time a caregiver went to visit them, etc.. The app has special large icons that make it easier for a person to express the care needs and feelings.

You can setup tasks remotely, add notes and add photos, it will then pop-up as a notification on your loved ones phone. Great for independent living.

This elderly phone app has background sensors that run 24/7 and lets family and caregivers see how much the phone/tablet device is being used and whether the battery is being kept charged,…

This senior citizen app works by consent - each person can chose what features to switch on and share.

description:
Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Whether you are potty training your toddler or doing elimination communication (EC or infant potty training) with your 0-18 month baby, you need this app!

Observation time is key for knowing your little one’s natural timing intervals (how often s/he goes potty) and keeping track of any baby signals (or “peepee dances”) you see.

But forget that printable log you got from my website! You can now digitally track how often your baby pees or poops during observation time, or potty training, with ease.

If you’ve wondered:

“How often does my baby pee or poop?”

“When should I offer the potty to my little one?”

“If I want to set a potty time reminder on my phone, how long should I set it for?”

…The Log is your answer.

No more paper printouts and chicken-scratch logging, no more guessing “how often does my little actually pee or poop?”…now you can simply open the app and, starting at either waking or feeding, track how often your baby or toddler goes. Then download a PDF of your results.

*You can also take a note of your little one’s signals or other observations by long-pressing the activity button, as you go.

After starting potty training, or if you’re doing EC…after a few hours of observation time (or a few days if you’re really inquisitive)…visit the Reports screen to easily see your baby’s intervals in graph or written format.

Set a potty time alarm based on your baby’s actual timing intervals, so your smart phone can remind you throughout the day when to offer a “pottytunity” - or chance to go potty.

If you have a toddler you’re potty training or wrapping up EC with, you can use this app to set an alarm based on your observations - welcome to your new potty training alarm app!

Track one or more babies, keep the logs separate, and easily re-set the data to start a new observation sesh any time (I recommend you re-log your child’s rhythms every few months or so to keep it fresh!).

Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Developed by me, Andrea Olson, author of Go Diaper Free and The Tiny Potty Training Book, whose 5 children were all out of diapers by walking, none requiring potty trained…a mom who has hardly had to change a poopy diaper and has saved over $10,000 in diapers across their babyhoods…you’re in good hands when it comes to observing your baby for elimination communication. Learn more at godiaperfree.com or via the app, itself.

PS - if you’re stinking at potty training, learn more with the free classes inside the app. If you don’t know what EC is, it’s the natural alternative to diaper dependence and potty training, and it starts as early as birth to 18 months. It’s what people have done for all of human history, long before diapers were invented. We also have a free class and books on that.

name: Poopi: Dog Health Journal
description:
Poopi was born out of love and concern for our own pawsome friend, Jack. Jack is a lovable, spirited dog who struggled with frequent bouts of diarrhea and discomfort. Nearly every month, we found ourselves back at the vet, trying to uncover the cause of his digestive issues. We soon realized that tracking his bowel movements, medications, supplements, and other key factors gave us and his vets the insights needed to get his health under control. Today, Jack is back to living his best life, and we’re here to help you do the same for your pup!

That’s why we built Poopi—to help pet parents everywhere support their furry friends’ health, just as we did for Jack.

With Poopi, you, too, can easily monitor and track your pet’s poop and overall digestive health. Our app is designed to help you identify irregularities, spot possible triggers, and share this information with your vet for better care. Whether you’re new to pet ownership or an experienced caregiver, Poopi offers meaningful insights that can significantly improve your pet’s quality of life. Equipped with monthly overviews and in-depth stats, you’ll have the tools to track your pet’s health trends and discuss any concerns or changes more effectively at every vet visit.

Take control of your pet’s digestive health today with Poopi, inspired by Jack and made for all pet parents!

Key Features:

* Poop Tracking: Log your dog's bowel movements quickly and easily to track date, time, and type—just like we did for Jack!
* Health Indicators: Monitor poop consistency, color, and frequency to detect potential health issues early on.
* Detailed Stats: Key stats to share with your veterinarian for improved diagnostic accuracy.
* Multi-Pet Support: Have multiple dogs or pets? Track each pet’s health individually with ease.
* Family & Friends Access: Share your pet’s profile with family members or friends and work together to maintain logs.
* User-Friendly Interface: Simple, intuitive design for effortless tracking  

Why Track Your Dog’s Poop?  For pets like Jack, regular monitoring of bowel movements can reveal early signs of health problems such as digestive issues, infections, parasites, and dietary intolerances. By tracking your dog’s poop, you stay ahead of potential health issues and ensure your furry friend’s well-being.

Inspired by Jack—download Poopi now!

description:
I'm developing this app on my own in my spare time outside of work, so that I can continue to offer it for free.

This app is free, ad-free, and without data collection. Forever.

You and you alone are responsible for your data, which is why it is not stored online.
Remember to create backup files regularly so that you don't lose them.
(Settings > Import / Export)

Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

It's possible to create your own symptom list in order to score them day after day, rating thef pain level intensity on a scale from 0 to 5.

It's also possible to record your meals, medications and add various notes, as well as your sleep schedules to highlight the causes of your symptoms. For example, it is easier to highlight the link between some of your meals and your possible stomach aches.

In addition to noting the daily evolution of the symptoms at different times of the day, it's also possible to enter an overall level of pain intensity over the course of a day in order to have a broader view of their evolution.

In short, Life-Notes offers what a simple notebook could do for you, but with a focus on tracking symptoms and providing statistics.

None of your data is sent online, 100% of your data is stored on your phone's memory.

Available languages: English, French

name: Pain Tracker & Diary
description:
This app helps you understand and precisely share what you feel daily and keeps track of what types of pain your treatments are helping.

WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?
You hurt. Your pain is chronic and complicated. You can’t remember everything. You want your doctors to understand, but you don’t know how to explain what you feel.

PAIN IS LIFE-CHANGING. HELP IS HERE.
Nanolume® developed the Pain Tracker & Diary to help you record the daily textures, intensities, and locations of what you feel, so you and your care team can better understand what you are suffering with and follow how your pain responds to medications and treatments.

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. In addition, by keeping such an integrated record, trends might emerge that would otherwise go unnoticed.

PAIN IS DIFFERENT.
Pain is a subjective (not objective) sensation that you cannot measure. Its assessment relies on each person’s ability to communicate what they feel. Nanolume® developed this digital diary to help you record what you feel every day.

INCLUDED FEATURES.
For each diary entry you create:
• Choose a Pain Type. Choose from a list of predefined pain types or create a customized pain type. Next, tap the icon of the pain type you feel is most intense (you can come back and add more types later).
• Select the Intensity. Select the intensity of your pain type using a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS).
• Draw an Outline. Use your finger to draw an “outline” of the type of pain you are experiencing on the front and back sides of a generalized map of your body.
• Calculated Surface Areas. The app displays the percent [%] of your body surface affected by each (or all) of the pain types you draw.
• Zoom. Need to see a larger image of your hand or foot? Double-tap: once to zoom x2; twice to zoom x4; a third time to restore the original size.
• Notes. Tap the “Notepad” icon located in the top-left corner of each opened diary entry to record any details of your medications or treatment results.
• Tap "Add Pain." Choose another pain type (layer) to draw.
• Save Your Diary Entry. Tap "Done" to create a snapshot of all the pain type layers you drew. The app attaches the date and time your entry was saved.
• Open a Saved Entry. Tap on the date and time of the entry you want to review. Look at the intensity, location, and surface area of each pain type you experienced (by touching the icon of the pain type you want to see) or see all the pain types at once and see how they overlap (tap the "All Layers" icon). Swipe the picture left or right to check how your other pain entries compare over time.
• Charts. View a summary of your data in "Charts."
• Forget to Save an Entry? Go back and recreate a "pain picture" from the past; then, use the "Calendar" icon to backdate the recreated entry.
• Calendar Backdating. Touch the "Calendar" icon to backdate any pain-picture you draw to create a record of what you remember from the past.
• Copy/Edit. Copy or edit a copy of a previous entry.
• CSV Export. Email or save a numeric file of your data, then open that data in a spreadsheet.
• Interactive Summary & Animation. Play an animation of your data to see how your pain types change within any period you choose by selecting the corresponding start/stop dates.
• PDF Export. Export your charts, drawings, and notes as a PDF file.

PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT.
Your data is stored on your device only and not collected or stored by Nanolume® LLC. Read our End-User License Agreement and Privacy Policy at www.nanolume.com.

Copyright © 2014-2024, Nanolume® LLC. All rights reserved. U.S. Patent No. 11,363,985 B2.

Retrain Your Brain. Reclaim a Life Beyond Chronic Pain.
Still living with chronic back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain—or other persistent pain that just won’t go away? Your pain is real. But it may not be coming from where you think.

Requires Subscription.
Free to download; an active subscription is required to use the app and access all features.

Pain can be learned by the brain—and the good news is: it can also be unlearned. This app helps you understand how chronic pain works and gives you the tools to gently rewire the brain’s pain pathways.

How Does It Work?
Chronic pain often continues after the body has healed. Why? Because your brain has learned to protect you by activating pain—sometimes even without injury. This is called neural circuit pain, and it’s more common than most people realize.

By using science-backed methods based on neuroplasticity, our app helps you calm the brain’s danger signals, reduce pain, and restore a sense of safety in your body.

Education Is Treatment
Knowledge is so powerful, in fact, that education about pain is a medically recognized form of treatment. Healthcare practitioners call it therapeutic neuroscience education—which is a fancy way of saying that someone is learning how pain really works in the brain.

Scientific studies show that this kind of education can:

Reduce physical pain

Improve movement and function

Lower fear and anxiety

Calm the nervous system

Support long-term recovery

Understanding pain is often the first step to relieving it.

What You’ll Find Inside the App:
Daily science-based lessons to reframe your understanding of pain

Interactive pain tracker to identify patterns and monitor your progress

Guided practices to calm fear and deactivate pain circuits

Tools to identify neural circuit pain vs. structural pain

Strategies for responding to pain triggers with confidence

Exercises that promote safety, movement, and emotional ease

Gentle coaching on how to retrain your brain using proven techniques

Who Is This App For?
You might benefit from this approach if:

You have chronic back pain, neck pain, or shoulder pain

Your pain started during a stressful time or flares with stress

Your pain changes locations, intensity, or comes and goes

You’ve been told “there’s nothing wrong,” but still feel pain

You’ve tried everything—yet nothing has worked long-term

You’re open to a mind-body approach rooted in science, not guesswork

This app is designed for people ready to understand their pain, not just manage it.

Track, Learn, Improve
Our built-in pain tracker helps you:

Log and visualize your pain patterns over time

Notice emotional or situational triggers

Spot progress and build momentum

Feel more empowered in your recovery

No Meds. No Surgery. Just Science.
This is not about positive thinking or ignoring your pain. It’s about giving your brain the right information—and practicing how to respond with calm, not fear. Over time, this helps deconstruct the neural pathways that keep pain alive.

Download Now — Start Rewiring Pain, One Step at a Time
Train your brain. Understand your pain. Live your life again.

Traditional gout apps tell you to avoid purines. But here's what they miss: dietary purines only account for about 30% of your uric acid levels. That's why avoiding "bad foods" often doesn't stop flares.

Urica tracks the full picture:

Real-world uses
• Sweep a hotel room or Airbnb for hidden cameras before you unpack
• Block ad trackers while browsing or using apps
• Find an unknown AirTag hidden in your bag or car
• Check a rideshare or rental vehicle for trackers
• Keep a private log if you need to report stalking to authorities

How it works

Hidden cameras
Scan your surroundings for infrared signals and lens reflections using the guided sweep mode.

Online trackers
Enable background blocking and we handle the rest—tracker domains are blocked in real time across all apps.

AirTags & Bluetooth trackers
1. Run a scan to list nearby trackers
2. Get a clear alert if an unknown device is following you
3. Use the proximity meter to locate it
4. Play a sound on supported devices to pinpoint the tag
5. Follow in-app steps to disable it

Tracking Protection VPN
When you enable background blocking, Tracker Detect Pro creates an Android VpnService tunnel entirely on your device. We inspect DNS lookups locally, block known tracker domains in real time, and forward allowed requests over TLS. No browsing data is sold or rerouted through third-party VPN servers—this tunnel exists solely to keep 24/7 tracker protection and per-app stats active even when the app is closed.

Full feature list
• Hidden camera scanner with infrared and lens detection
• On-device VPN for 24/7 online tracker blocking
• AirTag detector and AirTag finder for Android
• Bluetooth tracker detector for Find My accessories
• Background scanning with instant notifications

• Per-app tracker stats
• Play Sound on supported Apple devices
• Rename known devices to ignore your own gear
• Dark mode

Privacy and permissions
• Uses Bluetooth, Location, Camera, and Notifications to scan and alert
• VPN permission is used only for local DNS filtering—no traffic goes through third-party servers
• Detection history stays on your device unless you share it
• No account required

Tips for best results
• Keep Bluetooth and Location on
• Dim lights and move slowly for hidden camera scans
• Move slowly with the proximity meter—signal improves as you get closer
• Re-scan after leaving an area to confirm if a tracker is following you

Compatibility

• Does not pair or manage your own AirTags—that requires Apple Find My on iOS

name: Medication Log (Medicine)
description:
You can control your medication you are taking with Medicine Log!
Make a list of your medication, take log and it reminds you the time you take the medication by setting alarm.

＊＊User Guide＊＊

Initial Screen is the calendar.


1. Setting: You can customize the calendar.
2. Mark: You can add marks on the date of the calendar.
＊You can delete marks by selecting the same mark and then tap twice.
3. Alarm: Set vibration duration, volume and alarm sound.
4. Password: Set password.


＊From the left button＊
1. "Today" button: Go back to the today's date.
2. "Left" and "Right" button: Move the date right and left.
3. "Registration" button: Make a list of your medication. Press "New" then move to the registration screen.
4. "List" button: You can see the list of your medication log.


1. Press "Registration" button on the calendar screen → Press "New" → Move to the registration screen.
2. Enter the name of the medicine, duration of your medication, when you take it and set the alarm. → Press "Save".
3. When you save it, you can confirm that your medicined is added on the list.


1. After you saved the medication on the registration screen, go back to the calendar.
2. You can confirm the name of the medicine and when you take them on the lower part of the calendar.
3. After you take the medication, tap the name of the medicine.
4. Move to the "Did you take your medication?" screen.
5. Select "morning", "noon" or "night" from the drop-down list and then tap one of the buttons ◯, ☓, and △. →
Press "Save".
6. ◯ = you took the medication, ☓ = you forgot to take and △ = you took it late.
7. You can take a note (memo).

Support Android Wear Vibration

name: Doctor On Demand
description:
Doctor On Demand by Included Health offers 24/7 access to board-certified doctors, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists via secure video visits from your phone, tablet, or computer. When you're feeling sick, want a doctor’s note, need help with a prescription, and more, we make it easy to get quality telehealth anytime, anywhere—with or without insurance. Download the free Doctor On Demand app to get started.

Why Choose Doctor On Demand?

Fast Access to Online Doctors – See a board-certified, US-based provider with telehealth appointments anytime, day or night.

Therapy & Psychiatry – Book virtual visits for mental health concerns like stress, anxiety, depression, PTSD, trauma, and more.

Online Urgent Care, Treatment, Prescriptions – For colds, flu, allergies, skin conditions, UTIs, headaches, and more, our providers can send prescriptions to nearby pharmacies if medically appropriate.

Doctor’s Notes – Need a doctor’s note for work or school? We’ve got you covered. See an urgent care provider for help.

Insurance or Self-Pay – We work with major health plans and many employers to reduce the costs of visits for eligible members. If not covered, we offer affordable visit costs to all patients with no surprise bills.

How It Works

 1. Download the app and create an account for free.
 2. Choose to see the first available provider, or schedule a visit.
 3. Get personalized care, prescriptions, and treatment plans in an online visit.

Conditions We Treat
✔️ Cold, Flu & Sinus Infections
✔️ UTI Treatment Online
✔️ Acne, Rashes & Skin Issues
✔️ Allergies & Asthma
✔️ High Cholesterol, Diabetes & Thyroid Screening
✔️ Headaches & Migraines
✔️ Mental Health Support: Anxiety, Depression, Grief & More
✔️ Prescription Refills & Lab Orders

Frequently Asked Questions
🕒 When are doctors available?
Our virtual providers are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks

💲 How much does a visit cost?
You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.

👩‍⚕️ Who are the doctors?
Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.

🤳How does it work?
Join a telehealth visit to connect face to face with a provider from your phone, tablet, or computer in as little as ten minutes. Like an in-person visit, your provider will discuss with you how you’re feeling, your healthcare history, and propose a recommended treatment plan. Labs, screenings, and prescriptions will be sent to nearby facilities.

⚕️What can you treat?
Our urgent care doctors can treat hundreds of issues, including cold and flu, urinary tract infections, allergies, headache, sprains, and skin conditions. They can also order labs and screenings to help with preventative care and help manage chronic care conditions. Our extensive team of therapists and psychiatrists are able to treat anxiety, stress, depression, PTSD, trauma and loss relationships, and more.

Your Privacy is Our Priority
We adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines to protect your health data and personal information.

Our providers are unable to prescribe controlled substances.

Get Started Today
Join millions of patients who trust Doctor On Demand for fast, convenient, and reliable healthcare. Download the app now to sign up for free!

Fast Company: “Congratulations Timeshifter on helping to change the world.”

Timeshifter — Shift Work Edition — was developed to help shift workers reduce the underlying problem of circadian and sleep disruption inherent in shift work. With Timeshifter, you will receive highly personalized advice based on your sleep pattern, chronotype, work schedule, and personal preferences.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

It’s time to replace the myths with real science.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

WHY SHIFT WORKERS LOVE TIMESHIFTER

// Based on the latest sleep and circadian science
// Optimizes your sleep, alertness, and performance
// Reduces the negative effects of shift work on productivity, health, and quality of life

Using Timeshifter is as simple as taking small actions at specific times.

KEY FEATURES

// Circadian Time™: Advice is based on your individual circadian clock
// Practicality Filter™: Adjusts advice to work in the "real world"

// Fatigue Prediction: Warns you when to be extra cautious to avoid mistakes and accidents
// Advice Notifications: Get timely advice even without opening the app

NO EXPENSIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED

Timeshifter is a highly empowering experience, and it requires no special equipment. Just a sleep mask and your favorite dark sunglasses.

TRY IT FREE

A 30-day free trial is available — no commitment required! After your trial, you can choose to subscribe monthly ($6.99/mo) or annually ($69.99/yr).

Chase M.
"RISE helped me understand how vital sleep truly is. In only a few weeks, I found myself more focused, energetic, and productive at work."

Becky G.
"I could see where sleep debt was causing issues, like temper short, not comprehending things, moving slowly.  I had an epiphany... I'm getting 45min more sleep on average than I was before RISE."


UNLOCK BETTER SLEEP
Tired of the age-old "eight hours of shut-eye" advice? Go beyond buying a new mattress or pillow and discover the life-changing concept of Sleep Debt.

Scientifically proven to be a vital factor in your well-being, a low Sleep Debt can improve your life quality and even your longevity—while high Sleep Debt can cause fatigue and harm your health.

RISE calculates your Sleep Debt, helps you understand its impact on your energy, and guides you on how to lower it by improving sleeping habits. Learn about your melatonin window, when to prioritize sleep, and understand the real cost of those late nights—and how you can benefit from naps.

PERSONALIZED SLEEP TRACKER
Do you find your mind racing when your head hits the pillow? Can’t stop doom-scrolling on your phone? Feeling fatigued all day?

Based on your sleep data, circadian rhythm, and the latest research, we’ll make recommendations that fit your needs and guide you toward healthier habits, making you a better sleeper.

RISE will get you in bed on time, guide you when you can’t sleep, reduce the times you wake up at night, and make you feel less groggy in the morning.

DISCOVER YOUR CIRCADIAN RHYTHM
We all have an internal brain clock, our circadian rhythm, it signals to our body when to be alert or go into recovery mode. Everyone is unique, from when we perform our best to when we should sleep and wake up, so we use advanced algorithms to find your optimal sleep and activity window.

You’ll gain insight into your circadian rhythm and daily energy levels, helping you plan for a more productive day.

Sleeping refuels energy, and 83% of RISE users feel more energy in a week or less.

AUTOMATICALLY TRACK SLEEP
Through our integration with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Oura, and data from other sleep trackers on your phone, like Sleep Cycle and ShutEye, RISE can determine the hours of sleep you get every night, your sleep debt, the number of steps you take each day, as well as data from other activities that affect your sleep pattern.

WHY WE STARTED RISE
We want to help get ahead of the Insufficient Sleep Epidemic (CDC, 2014) we're experiencing, which has been steadily increasing since 1985. This Epidemic has led to elevated mortality rates (Cappuccio, 2010) as well as underperformance in most aspects of life (RAND, 2016).

- возможность загрузки историй и прослушивания их без подключения к интернету;
- регулярное пополнение библиотеки новыми историями и звуками;
- возможность рекомендовать друзьям.

Варианты и условия подписки:
- бесплатный доступ к 2 рекомендациям о том, как улучшить свой сон, а также возможность прослушать отрывок каждой истории перед сном (4 минуты);

- ежемесячное обновление библиотеки историй и звуков;
- два варианта подписки: ежемесячная и годовая.

Как подписаться:
Для подписки (доступ к полной библиотеке историй и звуков) необходимо выбрать кнопку "Купить подписку" в приложении и выбрать тариф "1 год" или "1 месяц". Если вы подпишетесь на годовую подписку в течение 7 дней, вы можете бесплатно отменить подписку. После 7 дней использования счет, связанный с аккаунтом, будет списана стоимость подписки в соответствии с выбранным тарифом. Ежемесячная подписка не включает пробный период, подписка автоматически продлевается в соответствии с предварительно выбранным вариантом подписки (месяц или год), если не отменить его не менее чем за 24 часа до окончания текущего периода.

name: Nomadic Adventure
description:
The mobile game "Nomadic Adventure" to promote the nomadic culture was created within the framework of the “Digital Adventure” project initiated by the Ministry of Education and Science of Mongolia and UNICEF Mongolia with the funding support of Maßvoll Stiftung under the aegis of the Fondation de Luxembourg.

The purpose of the game is to disseminate knowledge about Mongolian customs, lifestyle, traditional festivals, arts, geographical features, and wildlife to children as well as to introduce and pass on Mongolian heritage.

HOPA (Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure) game type is where a player must find items from a list that are hidden within a scene. This type of game is characterized by the fact that it provides a person with new cognitive knowledge quickly and effectively.

The principle of the game is to find items according to the list of words within a certain period of time and complete the task by clicking on the item. The player loses the game if he/she doesn't find the words within the given time frame. To increase the chances of winning the game, the player can use add-time and magnifying glass features.

Good luck on your journey!
